title: Diagnose Qwen2.5 Coder native Ollama tool-call response structure
description: Read-only capability/evidence diagnostic for qwen2.5-coder:14b-instruct-q4_K_S. Capture the actual Ollama /api/show and /api/chat response shape without changing OpenClaw configuration.
script:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge';$model='qwen2.5-coder:14b-instruct-q4_K_S';$ep=Join-Path $root 'ollama-endpoint-v414.json';if(-not(Test-Path $ep)){throw 'OLLAMA_ENDPOINT_ARTIFACT_MISSING'};$base=(Get-Content $ep -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).baseUrl;$show=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/show') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{model=$model}|ConvertTo-Json) -TimeoutSec 30;$caps=@($show.capabilities);Write-Output ('V442_057K_CAPS='+($caps -join ','));$tool=@{type='function';function=@{name='write_probe';description='Create a probe file';parameters=@{type='object';properties=@{path=@{type='string'};content=@{type='string'}};required=@('path','content')}}};$body=@{model=$model;stream=$false;messages=@(@{role='system';content='You are a tool-using agent. When a matching tool is available, call it instead of answering with JSON or prose.'},@{role='user';content='Use write_probe with path C:/3EN-Agent/workbench/qwen-native-tool-probe.txt and content QWEN_NATIVE_TOOL_OK. Do not answer in prose.'});tools=@($tool);options=@{temperature=0}}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30;$resp=Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri ($base+'/api/chat') -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 300;$msg=$resp.message;$props=@();if($null -ne $msg){$props=@($msg.PSObject.Properties.Name)};Write-Output ('V442_057K_MESSAGE_PROPS='+($props -join ','));$tc=@();if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'tool_calls') -and $null -ne $msg.tool_calls){$tc=@($msg.tool_calls)};Write-Output ('V442_057K_TOOL_CALL_COUNT='+$tc.Count);$content='';if($null -ne $msg -and ($props -contains 'content')){$content=[string]$msg.content};$safe=($content -replace '[
]+',' ');if($safe.Length -gt 1000){$safe=$safe.Substring(0,1000)};Write-Output ('V442_057K_CONTENT='+$safe);if($tc.Count -gt 0){for($i=0;$i -lt $tc.Count;$i++){$c=$tc[$i];$fn=$c.function;Write-Output ('V442_057K_TC'+$i+'_NAME='+[string]$fn.name);$argType=if($null -eq $fn.arguments){'NULL'}else{$fn.arguments.GetType().FullName};Write-Output ('V442_057K_TC'+$i+'_ARGS_TYPE='+$argType);$argJson='';try{$argJson=$fn.arguments|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 -Compress}catch{$argJson=[string]$fn.arguments};if($argJson.Length -gt 1000){$argJson=$argJson.Substring(0,1000)};Write-Output ('V442_057K_TC'+$i+'_ARGS='+$argJson)}};$artifact=Join-Path $root 'qwen-native-tool-diagnostic.json';[pscustomobject]@{model=$model;capabilities=$caps;messageProperties=$props;toolCallCount=$tc.Count;content=$content;hasStructuredToolCalls=($tc.Count -gt 0);capturedAt=(Get-Date).ToString('o')}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12|Set-Content $artifact -Encoding UTF8;Write-Output ('V442_057K_ARTIFACT='+$artifact);Write-Output 'V442_057K_CAPTURE=PASS'
